This contract aims to provide Frontex with Portable Cooled Multi-Sensor Binoculars, Portable Uncooled Thermal Cameras, Portable Cooled Thermal Cameras and Night Vision Goggles. Frontex intends to use the Portable Cooled Multi-Sensor Binoculars, Portable Uncooled Thermal Cameras, Portable Cooled Thermal Cameras, Night Vision Goggles (single image intensifier and double image intensifier) and Night Vision Binoculars for border surveillance in Operational Areas to detect and intercept illegal border crossings for the purpose of preventing and combating illegal immigration and cross-border crime.
